lines: If I ran a 5-person agency, these are the 3 automations I'd build first.
And each one takes one sentence.
When a new client fills my Jotform, create their project in ClickUp with every starter task.
When someone books a call on Calendly, create a deal in Pipedrive so nothing slips.
When a project is marked done in ClickUp, draft the invoice in Xero.
Join the waitlist — link in bio.
